# full-example-json

Argsbarg schema-first copy template (@sg schemagen, JSON schemas, REST CRUD)

## Execution

Invoke via shell:

```bash
full-example-json <subcommand> [options] [args]
```

## Commands

- **`full-example-json echo`** — Echo a message (MCP-friendly leaf).
- **`full-example-json render-json`** — Echo a JSON message (schema-first JSON leaf demo).
- **`full-example-json status`** — Show app version. (flags: --json)
- **`full-example-json workspaces get`** — List workspaces.
- **`full-example-json workspaces post`** — Create a workspace.
- **`full-example-json workspaces :id get`** — Get one workspace.
- **`full-example-json workspaces :id put`** — Replace a workspace.
- **`full-example-json workspaces :id patch`** — Patch a workspace name.
- **`full-example-json workspaces :id delete`** — Delete a workspace.

## Pitfalls

- Pass `--` before arguments that look like flags.
